Question:
What is a generatrix of a cone?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h106_q4_question_en.svg)

Choices.B: The line segment representing the height, which must equal the radius
Choices.C: A line segment joining the vertex to a point on the circumference of the base
Choices.D: The width of the net of the lateral surface

Solution: A generatrix lies on the lateral surface, and its length is generally not equal to the height.
